style: 2D game art asset for a stylised medieval-fantasy real-time strategy game, seen from a shallow three-quarter top-down angle (camera roughly 55 degrees above the ground, looking down at the front face). assets.prompt: A grand stone town hall of a human kingdom. Two square towers with steep blue slate roofs flank a wide cream-plaster hall under a hipped blue roof. A heavy timber gate sits under a carved stone arch, narrow windows glow warm gold, and crimson pennants fly from both tower tops.

A small medieval farmhouse: cream plaster walls with dark timber framing, a steep ochre thatched roof, a low stone footing, one warmly glowing window, and a narrow strip of ploughed brown field with green sprouts across its front.

A stout stone barracks: a long crenellated hall with a slate roof flanked by two short square towers, a heavy open timber door to a training yard, a crossed-swords iron sign above the door, and a crimson banner on a pole.
A timber lumber mill: rough plank walls under a mossy green shingle roof, a large iron circular saw blade mounted on the near side, and a neat stack of freshly cut logs beside it.

A stone blacksmith's forge: soot-darkened tile roof, a tall stone chimney with orange fire glowing at its top and heat shimmer above, a glowing orange forge mouth in the wall, and a black iron anvil standing out front.
A small stone chapel: steep blue slate roof, a tall square bell tower topped by a gold cross, and a large rose window glowing pale blue and gold.
An open-fronted siege workshop of heavy dark timber under a low hipped roof, with a half-assembled wooden ballista visible in the open bay and a large iron gear leaning against the wall.
A tall slender stone guard tower with visible stone courses, one narrow arrow slit glowing warm gold, a crenellated battlement at the top and a conical blue slate roof with a small crimson pennant.

A demonic nether gate: two jagged obsidian rock pillars framing a vertical tear in reality that pours molten orange-white light, a carved black keystone arch set with two pale skulls, and huge curved bone horns rising from either side. Cracked, blackened corrupted rock fused into its base.
A demonic soul well: a squat obsidian basin ringed with pale bone teeth pointing outward, brimming with glowing violet soul-light, one thin wisp of violet spirit rising from the surface.
A demonic blood pit: a jagged crater of black volcanic rock with a molten orange glowing interior, giant pale rib bones arching over it from both sides, and deep claw gouges torn into the rim.

A demonic brimstone forge: a squat black-stone building with a wide glowing orange furnace mouth and a short chimney throwing ember sparks, with clusters of glowing orange brimstone crystals stacked against its walls.
A hellmouth: an enormous circular maw sunk into black rock, ringed with huge pale fangs, its throat glowing molten orange-red, with two great curved bone horns rising behind it.

A demonic sacrificial altar: a stepped black-stone dais with a dark violet slab on top, three jagged violet rune stones floating and glowing above it, and a faint violet light beam rising from the slab.
A bone spire tower: a tall stack of enormous pale vertebrae with side spurs, narrowing as it rises, crowned by a horned demon skull whose eye sockets burn bright orange.

A gold mine entrance: a grey-blue rocky outcrop with a timber-framed adit cut into it, a dark tunnel mouth, glittering veins of gold ore in the surrounding rock and a small spill of gold nuggets at the threshold.
An exhausted gold mine entrance: a grey-blue rocky outcrop with a sagging timber-framed adit and a dark empty tunnel mouth. No gold, no glitter — dull, bare grey stone and a broken plank.
A single stylised broadleaf tree with a thick dark trunk and a rounded three-lobed deep green canopy.
A single stylised broadleaf tree, taller and narrower than usual, with a blue-green canopy and a slightly leaning trunk.
A single stylised old oak with a gnarled twisting trunk and a wide olive-green canopy.
A cluster of jagged glowing orange brimstone crystals erupting from a small patch of scorched black rock, the crystal cores bright and hot, the outer faces dark red.
A short wide cluster of glowing orange-red brimstone crystals splayed outward from cracked black rock.
A tall narrow spike of glowing orange brimstone crystal with two smaller shards at its base, growing from blackened scorched stone.
